en: Black‑and‑white view along a straight, slightly sloping residential street lined with 3‑ to 4‑storey townhouses. On the left foreground is a more ornate late‑19th‑century building with bay windows and floral decorations; on its corner a shop sign reads "Artur Modes. Korbwaren-Geschäft. Sport- und Kinderwagen-Lager." Several women, children and a man stand or walk on the sidewalks and in the street. At the far end stands a larger institutional building closing the perspective. The architecture is typical Central European, with steep slate roofs and dormer windows.
